# Clanky iOS - Full Docs

> Clanky iOS is the React Native / Expo client for attaching to the Eve relay, inspecting herdr state, and steering Clanky work from iPhone and iPad without inventing a second API.

Generated from the live docs site. Each section below is one page; see the heading and source path for context.

---

# Overview

Source: `README.md` - https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clanky-ios/?doc=overview

# Clanky iOS

![Clanky iOS showing the live Garden view with the selected Garden tab and ambient herdr worker sprites](apps/mobile/assets/garden/garden-hero.png)

React Native / Expo client for checking and steering Clanky from iPhone and
iPad. The app talks to the Eve relay channel inside the running Clanky brain,
mirrors the live herdr workspace/tab/pane hierarchy, and sends operator input
through the same relay contract used by the desktop tools. When the Mac's brain
is asleep, the app cold-starts it through an always-on supervisor daemon on the
tailnet, then dials the relay.

The old SwiftUI app has been removed. `apps/mobile` is the active app surface;
the shared TypeScript wire contract lives in the sibling
`../clanky-agent/packages/clanky-contract`; the local Ghostty terminal renderer
lives in `apps/mobile/modules/expo-ghostty-vt`.

## What You Can Do

- connect to an Eve relay over local network or Tailscale
- cold-start a sleeping Mac by waking the always-on supervisor daemon, then
  auto-connect once the brain is up
- store relay config in MMKV with a Keychain backup and keep the relay bearer
  token in Keychain
- inspect herdr workspaces, tabs, panes, agents, and terminal output
- choose native terminal attach or compatibility mirror mode
- send text and special keys to panes through relay `write` and `keys` ops
- start or continue Chat-with-Clanky Eve sessions
- run Clanky slash-command menus natively where the command makes sense on mobile
- route push notification taps back into the shell

## Contract Boundary

This repository is a client only. The canonical API is the current Clanky agent
implementation in the sibling checkout that contains `SPEC.md`. In this umbrella
workspace that is `../clanky-agent`; older standalone layouts may use `../clanky`
or `../clanky/clanky-agent`.

Inspect that checkout before changing client models or relay behavior, especially:

- `SPEC.md` for the iOS window behavior
- `scripts/clanky-up.ts` for lifecycle bootstrap output
- the supervisor lifecycle API (`/lifecycle/up|status|down`) and the shared
  `@clanky/contract` `lifecycle.ts` / `pairing.ts` shapes for cold-start and pairing
- `agent/channels/relay.ts` for relay operations and payloads
- `agent/lib/frontdoor-auth.ts` for bearer-token auth
- Eve session routes for Chat-with-Clanky conversation state

When the app needs new behavior, update or document the Clanky contract first,
then wire the mobile integration against that contract.

## Run

Install workspace dependencies from the repo root:

```bash
pnpm install
```

Generate native projects and run the custom Expo dev client:

```bash
pnpm mobile:prebuild
pnpm mobile:ios
pnpm mobile:start
```

Android uses the same app package and module graph:

```bash
pnpm mobile:android
```

The custom dev client is required because Clanky uses native modules Expo Go
cannot load: Ghostty terminal rendering, Keychain, MMKV, notifications, and
local authentication.

## Quality Gate

```bash
pnpm check
```

Root `pnpm check` runs the agent alignment check, the sibling contract
typecheck, the mobile typecheck/lint/import-cycle/Jest gate, and the hosted docs
build. The mobile-specific gate is:

```bash
pnpm --filter @clanky/mobile run check
```

The EAS build profiles, Maestro boot smoke, and non-blocking terminal perf smoke
are documented in `apps/mobile/QUALITY.md`.

## Documentation

The hosted docs UI renders this README as the overview.

```bash
pnpm docs:dev
pnpm docs:build
```

Architecture docs for the RN app live in `apps/mobile/docs/`, starting with its
`README.md` (architecture overview and module graph).

## Structure

```text
apps/
  docs/             hosted docs site
  mobile/           React Native / Expo app
packages/
  (reserved for future local client packages)
scripts/
  check-agents-alignment.sh
```
